author: OldSharpie
body:
ICED WARS

Hi everyone, this is a new map that I and other friends have been doing. It will be CTW gamemode, so you will have to capture the wools and bring them back to your Victory Monument. Here you have some info of the map.

Trailer on YouTube: http://youtu.be/OJ3uMPCRnSU

Team field: 

Spawn Kit (add a Diamond pickaxe to this):


Wool gear: 


Wool Room:

Middle island:


Complete Overview:

EDIT: As you may see, there is a core on the map. It has been removed due to people telling me that in Avicus you can't have mixed gamemode :)

World download: As this map was first build for OCN network, I have an XML file. I don't know how Avicus' PGM works so I will leave a Packaged Download with XML, not YML file. 
https://mega.co.nz/#!wNdAwB4a!icgcDNgu1u0nrijhFeYIh0X86luycCmzLAdocm_QwSw

The Avicus YML does not support  a core, and especially a mixed gamemode for example core and wools.
I suggest you remove the core/wools and place it all 3 monuments for each side I guess?
Other than that, it's a bit too small, but overal I really like this!
